paraphrase: The funeral rites of one who kept the sacred fires: when he falls ill he goes out with his fires; at death the body is carried to the cremation ground with the fires and burned with his sacrificial implements placed on his limbs; his widow lies beside him and is raised with a verse bidding her return to the world of the living; afterwards the bones are collected in an urn, and rites of appeasement and ancestral offerings follow.
